title: Monsanto pays Agent Orange veterans compensation
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Monsanto pays Agent Orange veterans compensation, about mid-1980s at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: In the mid1 1980s, Monsanto was required to pay millions in compensation to veterans of war who had been exposed to the highly toxic chemical

plain: On an episode about UFOs and past human experiments by drug and chemical companies, made with a guest named Brigham Buhler, podcast host Jesse Michels says that in the mid-1980s the chemical company Monsanto was required to pay millions in compensation to war veterans. These veterans had been exposed to Agent Orange, a highly toxic chemical. He uses it as an example of big companies harming people and being held to account only later.
